items.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's most capable broadly deployed model and the first it rates as reaching Critical cybersecurity capability under its Preparedness Framework, released in phases starting with select organizations before paid ChatGPT plans and the API. OpenAI claims state-of-the-art computer-use and coding results; API pricing is $10/$50 per million input/output tokens.
